reading: The sketch lays out a 'Team members' admin page: a page title and subtext, a blue '+ Invite' button top-right, a packed left toolbar of filter/search controls, a dark blue bulk-action bar, a large data table card listing team members with avatars/role/status/usage/last-active, an open status-filter dropdown menu floating over the table, and a bottom pager with result count and page buttons.
